status: Feasibility evidence only. No simulation has been run. Nothing here is a simulated result, a historical stockout or a cost.
data_label: Source data documented as synthetic (dummy) in the Data Context & Relationship Diagram; not operational performance.

descriptions.population_status: in_population or excluded, under the approved eligibility criteria
descriptions.exclusion_reasons: Why the material is excluded. Blank if in the population
descriptions.assumed_initial_inventory: Stock as supplied, ASSUMED to be inventory at the start of the horizon. Undated (DEF-12)
descriptions.lead_proxy_median_days__original_rows: Median promised interval in this view. Proxy, not an actual lead time (DEF-06)
descriptions.lead_proxy_median_days__exact_distinct_r: Median promised interval in this view. Proxy, not an actual lead time (DEF-06)
descriptions.lead_proxy_p90_days__exact_distinct_rows: 90th percentile of the promised interval in this view. Proxy only
descriptions.lead_observations_distinct: Promised intervals available on exact_distinct_rows. Copies are not independent observations
descriptions.pr_quantity_median__exact_distinct_rows: Median PR quantity per line. May not be the ordered quantity (DEF-05)
descriptions.active_months: Months with an issue, of 17. The same in both scenarios
descriptions.max_line_qty__scenario_a: Largest single issue line. The same in both scenarios, since copies repeat a kept value
descriptions.demand_evidence_tier: How much demand evidence exists, and what it allows (assumption S-16)
descriptions.lead_evidence_tier: How much lead-proxy evidence exists, and what it allows (assumption S-16)
descriptions.resampling_allowed_demand: Own-history resampling of demand is allowed
descriptions.resampling_allowed_lead: Own-history resampling of the lead proxy is allowed
descriptions.scenarios_identical_by_construction: No rule C1 rows, so Scenarios A and B hold the same records and must give identical results
descriptions.demand_materially_affected: Materially affected by the scenario choice (A-14)
descriptions.has_line_at_repeated_unit_peak: Has a line at a repeated unit peak (A-11)
descriptions.at_or_below_min_at_start: ARITHMETIC. Assumed initial inventory is at or below Min, so an order would be triggered on day 0 under the reference reading
descriptions.stays_above_min__scenario_a: ARITHMETIC. Initial inventory minus all issues stays above Min, so no order would ever be triggered under the reference reading
descriptions.stays_above_min__scenario_b: ARITHMETIC. As above, for Scenario B
descriptions.initial_inventory_covers_all_issues__sce: ARITHMETIC. Initial inventory is at least all issues in the window
ARITHMETIC. As above, for Scenario B
descriptions.single_line_exceeds_max: OBSERVED. One issue line is larger than Max, which conflicts with reading Max as an order-up-to level
descriptions.median_pr_quantity_exceeds_max: OBSERVED. Median PR quantity is larger than Max, which conflicts with reading Max as an order-up-to level
descriptions.lead_proxy_exceeds_horizon: ARITHMETIC. Median lead proxy is longer than the 518-day horizon, so an order may never arrive inside it

load_with: src.preprocessing.conform.read_conformed, using the column types above
